title: PMAVP: A Mamba-Inspired Deep Learning Framework for Antiviral Peptide Identification and Functional Activity Prediction.
snippet: Accurate computational prediction of antiviral peptides (AVPs) can accelerate peptide screening and reduce experimental costs. However, existing deep learning-based methods still suffer from severe class imbalance, over-reliance on handcrafted features and limited interpretability.
